maintenance_led.reason: Mostly engineering, program management and mission-support contracts for defense, space and nuclear programs, not aftermarket repair of installed products.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mainly US government and allied agencies: Department of Defense, NASA, Space Force, DOE and UK nuclear authorities.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grew through the Jacobs CMS and Jacobs Critical Mission Solutions-Amentum merger, but mainly grows via contract wins, not steady acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Cleared, safety- and regulation-critical nuclear, space launch and defense operations work makes switching contractors disruptive and slow.

notes: Amentum Holdings was formed by the 2024 merger of Amentum Services and Jacobs' CMS and Cyber & Intelligence units.
